answer: Every grade must carry a written rationale, a random subset of settled grades is re-examined by a fresh panel, and graders whose rationales correlate with the same flaw as their clones are linked and removed together, so a captured panel is detected by its own consistency. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. A farm supplies a gale template, produces a dawn signature across its seats, and is caught by the vertex re-reading: the gale is what it buys, the dawn is what it cannot hide, and the vertex is what it cannot argue with.
